page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring reliance on network-attached storage solutions. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The hardware configuration prioritizes raw CPU processing power over memory capacity, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles without the overhead of large memory allocations.

Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage and a relatively low memory-to-CPU ratio, which limits its utility for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data caching. Appropriate workloads for this instance profile include compute-heavy applications, batch processing, web serving, and front-end servers.
